newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Unocal Corp upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Unocal Corp upgraded.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Monday it raised its rating on the shares of Unocal Corp to buy from neutral with a 12-month price target of between $48 and $50 per share.

-- Analyst Paul Cheng said in a research note the shares traded at a significant discount compared with other domestic oil companies on the basis of enterprise value to cash flow and price as compared with net asset values.

-- "Although Unocal's second quarter results will likely be disappointing, we think much of the negative news has already been reflected and the company's previously announced share buyback program should provide strong support at the current levels," he said.
